title: Strains and stresses.
officialText:
Piping shall be installed so as to prevent detrimental strains and stresses in the pipe. Provisions shall be
made to protect piping from damage resulting from expansion, contraction and structural settlement. Piping shall be installed so as to
avoid structural stresses or strains within building components.
